class.name: Leaderboards
class.description: Scores go to Steam, Game Center or Play Games. Each leaderboard's name on a platform is [code]leaderboards/<id>/<platform>[/code] in Project Settings, as with [Achievements]. [codeblock] Leaderboards.submit_score("laps", 9512) var result = await Leaderboards.get_scores("laps", Leaderboards.SCOPE_FRIENDS) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_scores
method.description: Loads up to [param count] scores. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and [code]scores[/code], an [Array] of [Dictionary]s with [code]rank[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]score[/code] and [code]player[/code] ([code]true[/code] for the player's own). Play Games returns 25 at most, the others 100.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the platform the game runs on has leaderboards (Steam, Game Center or Play Games).

method.name: show
method.description: Opens the platform's screen for a leaderboard, or for all the game's leaderboards when [param id] is empty. On Steam, the game's leaderboard pages on Steam's website open in the overlay.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Submits a score, keeping the player's best. Does nothing where leaderboards aren't available.

constants.constant: The best among the player's friends.
Those around the player's own, or the best if they have none.
